The 2029 F1 Grand Prix is set to be one of the most glamorous weekends on the sporting calendar, and there's no better way to experience it than with a marbella yacht charter f1 grand prix 2029 package. Whether you want to cruise to Barcelona for the race or host a VIP viewing party in Puerto Banús, our fleet offers the perfect base for your F1 weekend.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for the F1 Grand Prix?

An F1 weekend is about more than just the race – it's about luxury, exclusivity, and celebration. Chartering a yacht from Puerto Banús gives you total flexibility: watch the race live on board via satellite, party at the marina, or even sail to Barcelona for the main event. With prices starting from €749 for 2 hours on a Tier A boat, you can enjoy world-class hospitality without the crowds.

Our Fleet for the 2029 F1 Weekend

How to Combine Your Charter with the F1 Race

The Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya is about 900 km from Marbella, but many guests choose to charter a yacht for the journey. Here's a typical plan:

  • Day 1: Depart Puerto Banús in the morning, cruise to a coastal stop like Cala del Faro for lunch, then continue to Barcelona (approx. 8-10 hours at 20 knots).
  • Day 2: Anchor near Port Olímpic or Port Forum. Watch the F1 race on your yacht's TV or from a nearby beach club.
  • Day 3: Return to Marbella or extend your charter to explore the Costa del Sol.

Alternatively, stay in Marbella and watch the race on board with a satellite feed. The Mangusta 80's flybridge is perfect for a party.

Best Spots to Watch the Race from the Water

While the circuit is inland, you can still enjoy the F1 atmosphere from the water in Barcelona. The best anchorages are:

  • Port Olímpic: Close to the marina with bars and restaurants showing the race.
  • Port Forum: Quieter, with space for larger yachts.
  • Offshore near the circuit: Some yachts anchor near the coast and use binoculars or screens.

In Marbella, you can anchor off the Golden Mile or near Cabopino and watch the race on a large screen on your yacht.

Party Like a VIP in Puerto Banús

Puerto Banús is the epicentre of Marbella's nightlife. After the race, return to port and hit the famous clubs: Pangea, Olivia Valère, or Aqwa Mist. Your charter yacht can serve as a pre-party venue – the Ferretti 94 and Mangusta 80 have spacious decks for dancing. Many guests book a 4-hour charter just for the sunset party.

Booking Tips for F1 2029

F1 weekends are peak season. Book your Marbella yacht charter at least 3-4 months in advance. For the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94, early booking is essential. All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks – no hidden costs. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and custom itineraries.
